dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with jagged, high-contrast light perimeters surrounding darker interior centers, primarily located on the anterior-dorsal and shoulder regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, distributed extensively across the mid-dorsal region and transitioning into smaller clusters toward the posterior-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of four prominent macro-annuli on the upper dorsal surface form a staggered, elongated quadrilateral; a cluster of three smaller blobs on the lateral mid-section forms a nearly equilateral triangle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small reddish-brown punctate marks on the posterior-dorsal region of the head; a distinct dark linear feature or indentation is visible at the lateral junction point of the right rear flipper base.
